apps.localizedDescription: Buzz Lab is a playground for your iPhone's Taptic Engine. Tap through Apple's built-in haptics, try 12 custom vibration patterns like Heartbeat, Drumroll, SOS and Earthquake, or drag around the Touch Pad to control a live rumble.

apps.name: MrLTTec Home
apps.subtitle: Control the TVs, speakers and lights on any Wi-Fi.
apps.localizedDescription: The MrLTTec Smart Home Tool, now on your iPhone. Join any Wi-Fi, tap Discover, and control what is on that network: Sonos speakers, Roku, Samsung TVs, Wemo plugs, WLED strips, WiZ lights and outlets, and turning on an Xbox. Includes network tools: list every device, ping, and check ports. No PC, server or internet needed.
